review.notes: Gate (worker's and hand-run) passes on every check; depcheck against the candidate order: 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE (GrothendieckTopoi #1520 and LocallyPresentableCategories #1926 are open new-roadmap suppliers not yet in the order).
